hook_text: Job alert: we're looking for a night keeper at the Marlow Reading Room.

scenes.narration: Job alert: we're looking for a night keeper at the Marlow Reading Room.
Rule one. Lock the front doors at midnight. Do not count the people who leave.
Rule two. The lamp on the last desk stays on. If it goes out, do not relight it.
Rule three. You will hear someone turn a page. It is not you. Do not look for them.
Rule four. At three in the morning, the library will ask you to return a book. Say you do not have it.
Rule five. If a reader sits down across from you, smile, and say, we are closed.
Rule six. Never go below the ground floor. The stairs are not on the plan.
Rule seven. If the lamp is already lit when you arrive, someone has been sitting in your chair. Do not ask who.
The night keeper before you wrote these rules. He is still on the staff list. And he is wearing your name tag.
So tell me. Do you follow the rules, or break one?
